fact: The IMF's July 2025 staff report says Niger's e-SISIC portal, active since 2019, was suspended after the July 2023 events and is in recovery, with an improved version (mobile app and USSD, including online payment by mobile money, cards and transfer agencies) being developed under the DGI Mobile Payment project.
title: Niger: Seventh Review under the Extended Credit Facility Arrangement, Requests for a Waiver of Nonobservance of Performance Criterion, Extension and Rephasing of the Arrangement, and Third Review under the Resilience and Sustainability Facility Arrangement (IMF Country Report No. 2025/200)
